name: Naisho no Natsuyasumi
source:
Father remarries, and main character gets a cute little sister. On a summer vacation day older brother gets lost to temptation and attacks his new sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父亲再婚，主角有了一个可爱的妹妹。暑假里，哥哥受不住诱惑，攻击了新妹妹。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
